notes.title: New Release Window Trailer!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528050/cbbdf308437ec1d019f165b612f9fa50b1fcd817.png[/img]

Hey all!  I know it's been quiet for Towerbolt the last while here, but I now have some big news and a new trailer to share!  Check out the new release window announcement trailer here: 

[previewyoutube=b17QYqNP1xI;full][/previewyoutube]

For those wanting the big news without watching the video, the game will be releasing [b]THIS YEAR[/b]!  I have been hard at work to push towards finishing the development of this game over the last few months, and am happy to share a brief glimpse into the full game here.

The steam demo for Towerbolt has been updated with some minor changes as well!  The playable content is the same as older steam demos, but if you'd like a taste of the early gameplay with some updated visuals, please take a look!

I'm pumped and excited to be nearing the last leg of the journey for this game.  Please wishlist and share! 

It's Time to Break Free!

-bordenary

notes.title: Demo and Discord are Open!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528050/3aada6ec652123b25d819aae618610d9264d9e54.gif[/img]

Big news!  There is now a demo available for Towerbolt!  It covers around the first two dozen floors of the game, feel free to play!

You can also now join the newly made Towerbolt Discord for following the game and for giving feedback.  Hope you enjoy the demo, and let me know what you think!  

Towerbolt Discord Link:  https://discord.gg/cj7ryR284Q

notes.title: Towerbolt at SIX Online and Indieland on 10/28!
notes.notes:
Hello!  This is the first big news announcement for Towerbolt.  I'm working on a playable Steam demo that will be coming out [i]very[/i] soon, but in the meantime, I wanted to broadcast some upcoming livestreams taking place this Saturday where Towerbolt will be featured!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528050/9602830153b4b5e529731144c95a91332790a3a1.png[/img]

First up, Towerbolt will be featured at the [b]Seattle Indies Expo Online[/b], a continuation of the Seattle Indies Expo that took place at PAX West back in September.  It'll be a livestream format giving 10 minutes of time to each game shown at SIX, including other additional titles as well!  It's a great way to see all the games from the in person event if you missed it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528050/4221a2cbbc401e986906b81b242e4c4b98ea842a.png[/img]

[b]Towerbolt will be featured around 5 PM PST on October 28th during the SIX Online stream at the link below![/b]

https://www.twitch.tv/seattleindies



But that's not all!  Later that evening, Towerbolt will also be featured at [b]IndieLand[/b], a livestream marathon charity event held by Jirard The Completionist, which highlights indie devs and indie games all for the cause of raising money for dementia research.

Read more about IndieLand here: https://www.indieland.org/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528050/9e0c780e4da82f7ccc86d616aaa04f4f690c378a.png[/img]

[b]Towerbolt will be featured at 10 PM PST on October 28th during the IndieLand stream at the link below![/b]

https://www.twitch.tv/thecompletionist


It's going to be a fun and busy day on Saturday.  I will be present at both events virtually to hang out and chat about the game.  As I mentioned at the top, I'm working on a playable demo for Steam and I intend to have it released very soon and before the events on Saturday.  Look forward to it!
